_comment: The markdown is what an operator reads; this file is what scripts/check_env.py
reads. test_check_env_20261029.py asserts the two agree, so neither can drift
from the other: a variable added to one and not the other fails the suite.
kind    - how it is validated: url | url_list | text | text_list | secret | inventory.
required- true when the deploy gate fails if this variable is missing or
malformed. 'required' applies to the profiles named in 'profiles'.
profiles- the deployment profiles the 'required' flag applies to. Omitted
why     - what breaks when it is missing. Keep it true.
meaning - one line, mirrored in the markdown table.
example - a placeholder value. Never a real address or token.
source  - where in the tree the variable is read, so a reader can check it.

variables.name: HIVE_URL
variables.why: Every bus call the doctor makes goes through it; unset and the doctor sees no bus at all.
variables.meaning: Base URL of the graeae-hive bus.

variables.name: HIVE_BUS_TOKEN
variables.why: Worker-tier bearer token; only needed when the bus requires worker auth.
variables.meaning: Optional worker-tier bearer token.

variables.name: HIVE_BUS_ADMIN_TOKEN
variables.why: The doctor registers as an orchestrator and calls /v1/admin/*; both use the admin token.
variables.meaning: Admin-tier bearer token; the doctor needs it to register as an orchestrator and to call /v1/admin/*.

variables.name: HIVE_FLEET_INVENTORY
variables.why: Without it no host address is known, so restarts and token-mismatch auto-fix are refused.
variables.meaning: Path to the fleet inventory JSON. No default path, because a default path would itself carry an address.

variables.name: ARGONAS_SSH_HOST
variables.why: Needed to build ssh:// clone URLs and to run ARGONAS discovery; the NFS mount covers cloning without it.
variables.meaning: ARGONAS hostname or address, used to build ssh:// clone URLs and to run ARGONAS discovery.

variables.name: ARGONAS_SSH_PASS
variables.why: Discovery only; the doctor never needs it to clone.
variables.meaning: Password for the ARGONAS discovery user.

variables.name: DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_BASE_URL
variables.why: Serves the triage and review phases and every unknown phase; unset disables the model call entirely.
variables.meaning: OpenAI-compatible base for the triage/review phases and any unknown phase.

variables.name: DOCTOR_TRIAGE_BASE_URL
variables.why: Defaults to DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_BASE_URL; only needed to send triage somewhere else.
variables.meaning: Triage phase base. Defaults to DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_BASE_URL.

variables.name: DOCTOR_REVIEW_BASE_URL
variables.why: Defaults to DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_BASE_URL; only needed to send review somewhere else.
variables.meaning: Review phase base. Defaults to DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_BASE_URL.

variables.name: DOCTOR_FIX_BASE_URL
variables.why: Where the fix model is served; unset disables the fix phase with one log line.
variables.meaning: Fix phase base (where the fix model is served).

variables.name: DOCTOR_FALLBACK_BASE_URLS
variables.why: With no rungs there is no failover; the phase base is the whole chain.
variables.meaning: Comma list of local bases tried after the phase base, in order. No default rungs.

variables.name: DOCTOR_FALLBACK_MODELS
variables.why: Parallel to the fallback bases; does nothing with no bases.
variables.meaning: Parallel list of model ids, one per fallback base.

variables.name: DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_MODEL
variables.why: The model id the open-weight path asks for; there is no safe default to guess.
variables.meaning: Model id for the open-weight path.

variables.name: DOCTOR_OPENWEIGHT_API_KEY
variables.why: Only when the serving side wants a key.
variables.meaning: Key for the open-weight path, when the server wants one.

variables.name: DOCTOR_REVIEWER_HEALTH_URL
variables.why: Unset means assume healthy; the requeue cap still applies.
variables.meaning: Optional bounded probe used by the loop sweep before an automatic requeue.

variables.name: HIVE_TYDEUS_BASE_URL
variables.why: Unset leaves the strict-route coder's base checked for shape only, and logs that once.
variables.meaning: Pins the exact base the strict-route coder must be served from.

variables.name: MNEMOS_URL
variables.why: Loop-event fetches go to MNEMOS; without it the doctor cannot classify a failed loop.
variables.meaning: MNEMOS base URL (MCP bridge, Settings.mnemos_url, loop-event fetches).

variables.name: MNEMOS_TOKEN
variables.why: fetch_loop_events returns None without it, so the doctor's loop classification silently stops.
variables.meaning: MNEMOS bearer token.

variables.name: HIVE_BUS_URL
variables.why: Only the deepseek spend alert reads it.
variables.meaning: Bus base URL used by hive/tools/deepseek_spend_alert.py.

variables.name: CIXMINI_IP
variables.why: cixmini's address is its own variable because the restart recipe needs it separately from the inventory.
variables.meaning: Address of the cixmini host, used by the restart allowlist.

variables.name: DOCTOR_CIXMINI_SUDO_USER
variables.why: The restart recipe needs a sudo user; unset and the cixmini restart is refused.
variables.meaning: Sudo user for the cixmini restart recipe.

variables.name: CIXMINI_SSH_PASSWORD
variables.why: Only needed when cixmini's inventory entry says auth=password.
variables.meaning: SSH password for the cixmini host.

variables.name: HIVE_AGENT_STALE_SECONDS
variables.why: Optional. Shortens the window after which an agent with no heartbeat is marked offline; unset keeps the built-in 300 s rule.
variables.meaning: Seconds without a heartbeat before the bus reaper marks an agent offline (values above 300 are ignored).

variables.name: AGENT_BUS_DB
variables.why: Optional. Overrides the sqlite database path; unset keeps /srv/agent-bus/agents.db.
variables.meaning: SQLite bus database file used when HIVE_BACKEND=sqlite.

variables.name: HIVE_BACKEND
variables.why: Optional. Selects the persistence backend; unset keeps sqlite.
variables.meaning: Persistence backend: sqlite, oracle, or db2.

variables.name: ORACLE_DSN
variables.why: Only needed for HIVE_BACKEND=oracle; unset and oracle rows cannot be read.
variables.meaning: Oracle connection string for the oracle backend.

variables.name: DB2_DSN
variables.why: Only needed for HIVE_BACKEND=db2; HIVE_DB2_DSN is honoured as a fallback.
variables.meaning: Db2 connection string for the db2 backend.

variables.name: CLAIM_LEASE_SECONDS
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 1800.
variables.meaning: Claim lease lifetime in seconds.

variables.name: CLAIM_SCAN_WINDOW
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 10000.
variables.meaning: Maximum queued rows scanned per claim pass.

variables.name: HIVE_HOST_DENYLIST
variables.why: Optional. Empty (unset) denies nothing.
variables.meaning: Comma-separated hostnames never eligible for claims.

variables.name: HIVE_LLM_CAP_GATE
variables.why: Optional. Unset (or 0) disables the gate.
variables.meaning: Set to 1/true/yes/on to exclude hosts with no llm-* provider from LLM work instead of maintaining HIVE_HOST_DENYLIST by hand.

variables.name: AGENT_HOST
variables.why: Optional. Defaults to the short hostname.
variables.meaning: Agent hostname announced at registration.

variables.name: DOCTOR_TRIAGE_MODEL
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps cerberus-reviewer.
variables.meaning: Model id for the doctor triage phase.

variables.name: DOCTOR_REVIEW_MODEL
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps cerberus-reviewer.
variables.meaning: Model id for the doctor review phase.

variables.name: DOCTOR_FIX_MODEL
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps qwen38.
variables.meaning: Model id for the in-doctor fix phase.

variables.name: DOCTOR_VERDICT_COMPLETION_DRY_RUN
variables.why: Optional. Unset (or anything but 1) performs the call.
variables.meaning: Set to 1 to log the verdict-completion call without performing it.

variables.name: LOOP_WINDOW_SEC
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 1800 (30 min).
variables.meaning: Loop-outcome window in seconds for escalation counting.

variables.name: LOOP_ESCALATE_THRESHOLD
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 3.
variables.meaning: Failures within the loop window before a loop escalates.

variables.name: MAX_SSH_PER_HOUR
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 3.
variables.meaning: Cap on SSH recovery attempts per host per hour.

variables.name: MIN_HOST_COOLDOWN
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 1800.
variables.meaning: Seconds a host stays cooled down after a recovery attempt.

variables.name: MAX_TOKEN_FIX_PER_HOST
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 3.
variables.meaning: Cap on token-fix attempts per host.

variables.name: NEEDS_REVIEW_SCAN_INTERVAL
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 3600.
variables.meaning: Seconds between needs-review follow-up sweeps.

variables.name: NEEDS_REVIEW_OLDER_HOURS
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 24.
variables.meaning: Only follow up needs-review rows older than this many hours.

variables.name: REVIEW_FOLLOWUP_MAX_PER_SWEEP
variables.why: Optional. Unset keeps 3.
variables.meaning: Maximum review follow-ups performed per sweep.

variables.name: HIVE_ARGONAS_GIT_ROOT
variables.why: Optional. Unset uses the registry's NFS mount constant.
variables.meaning: Local root of the ARGONAS git mirror.

variables.name: HIVE_SHARED_SECRET
variables.why: Optional. Unset disables shared-token auth on the bus.
variables.meaning: Shared token the bus compares against the X-Hive-Token header.
